description: Edits a contact as the contact card's pencil does: name, phone (with area code), email, company_name, address (keep its zip if it had one), access_method (how the crew usually gets in, e.g. someone is home, key is hidden, lockbox; for one visit or this and later visits of a plan use add_booking_note kind access_method instead), access_notes, special_instructions, has_pets, pet_details, preferred_cleaner, preferences, availability_notes, contact_type. Send only the fields to change; a contact always keeps a name, phone or email. expected (field -> the value you read) refuses the save if someone changed it since (stale_write). A rename reaches the Quo card when the business's write setting allows. Renaming a staff contact to a name another staff member holds answers name_conflict with that person: ask your user, then send the name again with same_person_as (that staff id: this contact is them) or separate_person: true (a different person; the name stays on this contact only). platform_customer links the contact to its booking platform customer id; an id another contact holds is refused with that contact. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.
